proof_summary: Let \(N=23492890653051=3\cdot37\cdot43\cdot42307\cdot116341\), a product of five primes. Multiplicativity of the gcd-sum and its prime value \(G(p)=2p-1\) give \(G(N)=610815156979325\), so \(1+G(N)=26N\); hence \(\gcd(N,1+G(N))=N\) and therefore \(a(N)=1\) although \(N\) is composite.
